en: A tinted black‑and‑white studio-style photograph of a young uniformed guard standing beside a striped sentry box. The soldier wears a dark shako with a tall white plume and a sunburst-like badge, a tunic with decorative braiding, high boots, and carries a rifle slung over his shoulder. The sentry box has diagonal green-and-white stripes. The background is plain, suggesting this is a posed portrait rather than an outdoor scene.
